parameters.name: EndTimestamp
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. Unit: seconds. If you do not specify this parameter, the current time is used.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to obtain the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description: The time interval. Unit: seconds. The value must be an integral multiple of 60.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

*   **cn-hangzhou:** the Chinese mainland.
*   **ap-southeast-1:** outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: StartTimestamp
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the error codes. Valid values:

*   **waf:** error codes that are returned to clients from WAF.
*   **upstream:** error codes that are returned to WAF from the origin server.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-response-code-trend-graph --start-timestamp 1665331200 --end-timestamp 1665386280 --interval 300 --type waf --resource www.aliyundoc.com --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi DescribeResponseCodeTrendGraph --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceManagerResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm000q' --Type waf --StartTimestamp 1665331200 --InstanceId waf_cdnsdf30000 --Resource 'www.aliyundoc.com' --EndTimestamp 1665386280 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Interval 300
